summary: kind=trigger, feature 'After-update Apex trigger on Case that writes CaseMilestone.CompletionDate to complete the First Response milestone, plus its test class'. Three components emitted at apiVersion 67.0: CaseMilestoneTrigger (after update on Case, one line), CaseMilestoneService (one SOQL, one DML, partial-success SaveResult loop, CompletionDate = NULL as both the open-milestone filter and the idempotency guard) and CaseMilestoneServiceTest (@IsTest(SeeAllData=true), four assert-bearing methods, one of which drives a real Case update so the trigger itself runs). The skill's four-file bundle was reduced to the documented two-file shape because the plan declares no handler output and no step in this build deploys TriggerHandler/TriggerControl/Trigger_Setting__mdt. No compile check ran: the build is design-only with no org, and there is no offline Apex compiler in the sf CLI.

findings.title: The completion signal is a proxy, and Q50's answer named a different one
findings.detail: D10 settled the mechanism (after-update Apex stamping CompletionDate) but no clarification settles the Case change that means 'the agent responded'. Q50's recorded answer names the first outbound EmailMessage. The emitted service completes when a Case leaves Status 'New' — the transition references/examples.md Example 1 documents and the one both of this build's business processes share. A case can leave New without a customer-facing reply, and an agent can reply without leaving New.
findings.recommendation: Take it to the M4 gate: either accept 'leaves New' as the signal, or re-answer Q50 and plan an after-insert trigger on EmailMessage (Incoming = false) as a separate step. The rule is one @TestVisible constant (OPENING_STATUS), so a change is one line.

findings.title: Two-file shape emitted instead of the skill's four-file handler bundle
findings.detail: references/code-examples.md and apex/apex-design-patterns both name a TriggerHandler subclass as the trigger adapter. plan.json steps[M4-S05].outputs[] declares no handler, and a search of plan.json returns zero occurrences of TriggerControl, ApplicationLogger or Trigger_Setting__mdt in any step's outputs[] — so a handler extending templates/apex/TriggerHandler.cls would not compile in the org this build produces. The cost is no recursion guard, no depth counter, no skipOnce() and no TriggerControl kill switch.

evidence.plan_search: TriggerControl=0, ApplicationLogger=0, Trigger_Setting__mdt=0, TriggerHandler=1 (this step's templates[] only)

findings.recommendation: If the handler shape is wanted, it is a plan amendment (amend-step) adding the handler to outputs[] and the three template components to some step's outputs, then a rebuild — not a code tweak.

findings.title: TestDataFactory defaults collide with this build's two active Case validation rules
findings.detail: templates/apex/tests/TestDataFactory.createCases ships Origin = 'Email', which is not one of the three values this build's CaseOrigin standard value set defines, and sets no Priority. M3-S01's Origin_Must_Be_Known and Priority_Required_On_Agent_Save would both reject every Case the factory builds. The test passes Origin = 'Web' and Priority = 'Medium' through the factory's overrides map.
findings.recommendation: No change needed here. Any later step whose test builds a Case through the same factory needs the same two overrides — worth a line in the build's own test conventions.

findings.title: code-examples.md's COMPLETING_STATUSES set does not fit this build's status ladder
findings.detail: The cited bundle's constant is {'Working','Escalated','Closed'}. 'Working' appears in neither Support_Process nor Billing_Process in this build, so two thirds of that set would never match and the remaining value would complete the first-response milestone only at case closure. The emitted service uses 'leaves New' instead.
findings.recommendation: None — recorded so a reviewer comparing the emitted service against the skill sees the divergence was deliberate.

findings.title: No compile check ran, and no offline one is possible
findings.detail: The sf CLI apex command group retrieves logs, runs tests and executes anonymous blocks; only sf apex run --file reads a local file, and it executes that file against a required --target-org. This build is design-only with no org on file, so AGENT_CONTRACT.md Gate C check 3 did not run. Reported as not run, never as passed.
findings.recommendation: The reviewer's manual acceptance line at the M4 gate is what stands in for it: every non-platform identifier traced to the cited skill or template.

The cited skill was corrected today (commit b821294e2) and its code-examples.md now carries a deployable bundle with source-line citations and explicit UNVERIFIED markers, so this step copied identifiers rather than recalling them.

process_observations.observation: A second record-triggered automation on Case is being built concurrently at M4-S03 (a before-save flow) while this step adds an after-update trigger, and nothing in either step's declared outputs records the combined order of execution on a Case save.
Nothing in the plan names the Case change that means an agent responded; Q50's answer named the first outbound EmailMessage and D10 replaced the mechanism without replacing the signal.

requireActiveProcess() takes LIMIT 1 over any active SlaProcess, so in an org with an unrelated active process the run fails on the milestone assertion rather than on a sharper filter; the skill documents no narrower query and none was invented.
A second automation on Case now exists in this milestone, and the order in which the before-save flow and this after-update trigger touch a Case save is not recorded anywhere.
process_observations.followup_reason: It is the agent that budgets a whole Case save across flow and Apex, which is the question two concurrent automations on one object raise.

process_observations.observation: The emitted bundle is the only Apex in the build and the only artefact under a coverage gate, and no compile or test run was possible here.
process_observations.followup_reason: If the M4 gate wants coverage that does not depend on an org's entitlement configuration, it is the agent that designs the seam and the additional cases.
